summary: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting a Sept 29, 2026 engagement letter with Donerail Group Co LLC, an affiliate of then-director William Zachre Wyatt, for transaction advisory services tied to its previously announced Aug 17, 2026 merger with Fort Robotics, Inc. via wholly-owned Hugo Merger Sub Inc. Terms: $350,000 cash fee plus up to $75,000 expense reimbursement, payable at closing. A special committee of independent directors (Vescio, Gold, Seides) and the Audit Committee approved both the Donerail and Securities Grant agreements. Watch closing timing, redemptions, and related-party conflict risk.
